wc:minerva-command-dialog.summary: Searchable command palette in a modal, with a global shortcut.
wc:minerva-command-dialog.description: Command palette (`<CommandDialog>` of React): a searchable list of commands in a modal dialog. Type to filter (title, description, group and keywords), move with ArrowUp / ArrowDown (Home / End while the query is empty) over the results (combobox + listbox with `aria-activedescendant`), choose with Enter or a click; Escape (topmost layer only) or an overlay click closes it. Focus moves to the search input, is trapped, and returns to the opener on close. An optional global `shortcut` (e.g. "mod+k") opens it.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Title of the dialog (default: localized "Command palette")

properties.name: description
properties.description: Description of the palette (default: a localized hint)

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Placeholder (and accessible name) of the search input (default: a localized hint)

properties.name: emptyText
properties.description: Text shown when nothing matches (default: localized "No matching results")

properties.name: shortcutLabel
properties.description: Shortcut hint rendered as `<kbd>` next to the title, e.g. "⌘K"

properties.name: shortcut
properties.description: Global keyboard shortcut(s) that open the palette, e.g. "mod+k" (Cmd+K on macOS, Ctrl+K elsewhere). Modifiers: mod, ctrl, meta/cmd, shift, alt/option. The attribute takes a comma-separated list ("mod+k, /").

properties.name: resultsLabel
properties.description: Accessible label of the results list (default: localized "Command results")

properties.name: enterLabel
properties.description: Key hint at the end of the search input (default: localized "Enter")

properties.name: items
properties.description: Commands to search (disabled items are never shown)

properties.name: filter
properties.description: Custom search, e.g. to rank results by match quality. Receives the enabled items and the trimmed query (never empty) and returns the matching items in display order (then capped at `maxResults`). By default, items whose group, title, description or keywords contain the query (case-insensitive) are kept in `items` order.

CommandDialogProps.open: Controlled open state; leave undefined for uncontrolled
CommandDialogProps.onOpenChange: Called with the requested open state (shortcut, selection, Escape, backdrop click)
CommandDialogProps.items: Commands to search; disabled items are never shown
CommandDialogProps.onSelect: Called with the chosen item (click or Enter); the palette then closes
CommandDialogProps.title: Title of the dialog; defaults to the localized "Command palette"
CommandDialogProps.description: Accessible description of the palette; defaults to a localized hint
CommandDialogProps.placeholder: Placeholder of the search input; defaults to a localized hint
CommandDialogProps.shortcutLabel: Shortcut hint rendered as <kbd> next to the title, e.g. "⌘K"
CommandDialogProps.shortcut: Global keyboard shortcut(s) that open the palette, e.g. "mod+k"; modifiers: mod, ctrl, meta/cmd, shift, alt/option
CommandDialogProps.filter: Custom search, e.g. ranking results by match quality: receives the enabled items and the trimmed query (never empty) and returns the matching items in display order (then capped at maxResults); defaults to a case-insensitive substring match kept in items order
CommandDialogProps.resultsLabel: Accessible label of the results list
CommandDialogProps.enterLabel: Key hint shown at the end of the search input; defaults to the localized "Enter"
CommandDialogProps.className: Additional class name of the dialog panel

CommandItem.id: Unique id, passed back through onSelect
CommandItem.title: Main label
CommandItem.group: Group name, shown as a badge and matched by the search
CommandItem.disabled: Hides the item from the results
